upload.install_instructions: *---------------------------------------------------------------- ------ * 1. Upload entire XML to your AS/400 to a source file 112 long, into any mbr * name not in this XML (suggest member name like ABCX or XYZX). The source * file must be in the library where source and objects are to be installed. * * 2. If you have XMLPREVIEW installed, skip to step 3. * * Copy the text between the start tag <install_program> and the end * tag </install_program> into any member name (your choice) * in file QRPGLESRC member type RPGLE. CRTBNDRPG to compile. * NOTE: You need extract the install program only once, this same program * will install any upload on this page. * * 3. Call the install program (or execute XmlPrevew) passing these 3 parms. * 'your-member-name you uploaded this text into' * 'your-source-file-name the member is in' * 'your-library-name the source file is in' * * The various source members will be extracted and the objects required * for the application will be created in your-library-name. *---------------------------------------------------------------- ------

Option - Hilfe :XH3.Option (DLTOPT) :P. Angeben, ob zusätzliche Prüfungen durchgeführt werden sollen, bevor der Journalempfänger gelöscht wird. .* :P. Die Angaben zu den unten aufgeführen Sonderwerten (*NONE, *IGNTGTRCV, *IGNINQMSG und *IGNEXITPGM) wurden der Online-Hilfe des Befehls DLTJRNRCV V4R4 entnommen und müssen nicht zwangsläufig mit den Nachfolgeversionen des OS/400 übereinstimmen. .* :P. Im Zweifelsfall sollte die aktuelle Online-Hilfe des Befehls DLTJRNRCV durchgesehen werden. .* :IMHELP name='COM/OPTPARM'. .* :PARML. :PT.:PK DEF.*NONE:EPK. :PD.Das Löschen des Journalempfängers soll versucht werden, ohne die Schutzprüfungen zu ignorieren, die vor dem Löschen eines Journalempfängers durchgeführt werden. .* :PT.:PV.*IGNTGTRCV:EPV. :PD.Das System überprüft nicht, ob alle diesem Journal zugeordneten fernen Journale, die sich direkt hinter diesem Journal auf einem Zielsystem befinden, vollständige Kopien dieses Journalempfängers haben. Die Löschoperation wird durchgeführt, auch wenn eines dieser fernen Journale noch keine vollständige Kopie hat. Diese Schutzmaßnahme für einen Journalempfänger fängt an, wenn das ferne Journal mit der API QjoAddRemoteJournal hinzugefügt wurde und endet, wenn das Journal mit der API QjoRemoveRemoteJournal entfernt oder wenn es gelöscht wird. Weitere Informationen über APIs enthält das Handbuch System API Reference, IBM Form SC41-5801. .* :PT.:PV.*IGNINQMSG:EPV. :PD.Anfragenachricht ignorieren. Die Anfragenachricht CPA705E wird ebenfalls nicht angezeigt, auch wenn der Empfänger an ein fernes Journal angehängt ist. Die Löschoperation wird durchgeführt. .* :PT.:PV.*IGNEXITPGM:EPV. :PD.Benutzerausgangsprogramme ignorieren. Angeben, Alter in Tagen ab dem die Journalempfänger gelöscht werden sollen. .* :IMHELP name='COM/REQPARM'. .* :PARML. :PT.:PV.Anzahl Tage:EPV. :PD.Alter in Tagen. :EPARML. .* :EHELP. .* .*-------------------------------------------------------------------- .* Hilfetext für Schlüsselwort LOGLVL .*-------------------------------------------------------------------- :HELP name='DLTOLDJRNR/LOGLVL '. Log level - Hilfe :XH3.Log Level (LOGLVL) :P. Delete old Journal Receiver (DLTOLDJRNR) - Help :P. The DLTOLDJRNR deletes all old journal receivers of a journal. A journal receiver is considered as old if its age is older or egal the age specified. .* :EHELP. .* .*-------------------------------------------------------------------- .* Hilftext für Schlüsselwort JRN .*-------------------------------------------------------------------- :HELP name='DLTOLDJRNR/JRN '. Journal - Help :XH3.Journal (JRN) :P. Specifies the name and library of the journal whose receivers are deleted. .* :IMHELP name='COM/REQPARM'. .* :PARML. :PT.:PV.journal-receiver-name:EPV. :PD.Specify the name and library of the journal whose receivers are deleted. :EPARML. :P. The possible library values are: .* :PARML. :PT.:PK DEF.*LIBL:EPK. :PD.All libraries in the job's library list are searched until the first match is found. :PT.:PV.*CURLIB:EPV. :PD.The current library for the job is searched. If no library is specified as the current library for the job, the QGPL library is used. :PT.:PV.library-name:EPV. :PD.Specify the name of the library to be searched. :EPARML. .* :EHELP. .* .*-------------------------------------------------------------------- .* Hilfetext für Schlüsselwort DETACH .*-------------------------------------------------------------------- :HELP name='DLTOLDJRNR/DETACH '. Save option - Help :XH3.Save option (SAVOPT) :P. Specifies if a journal receiver must be saved before it can be deleted. .* :IMHELP name='COM/OPTPARM'. .* :PARML. :PT.:PK DEF.*SAVEDONLY:EPK. :PD.A journal receiver must be saved before it can be deleted. :PT.:PV.*ALL:EPV. :PD.All journal receiver that match the criteria are deleted. :EPARML. .* :EHELP. .* .*-------------------------------------------------------------------- .* Hilfetext für Schlüsselwort DLTOPT .*-------------------------------------------------------------------- :HELP name='DLTOLDJRNR/DLTOPT '. Option - Help :XH3.Option (DLTOPT) :P. Specifies whether additional checking should not be done before a journal receiver is deleted. .* :P. Please check the online help text of the DLTJRNRCV command to make sure that the help text of the DLTOLDJRNR command is still in sync with the current version of OS/400. .* :IMHELP name='COM/OPTPARM'. .* :PARML. :PT.:PK DEF.*NONE:EPK. :PD.The journal receiver delete is attempted without ignoring any of the protective checks which are done before a journal receiver is deleted. .* :PT.:PV.*IGNTGTRCV:EPV. :PD.The system does not verify that all remote journals associated with this journal that are immediately downstream on a target system have full copies of this journal receiver. The delete operation continues even if any of those remote journals does not have a full copy. This protection on a journal receiver only applies beginning when the remote journal was added using the Add Remote Journal (QjoAddRemoteJournal) API, until it is removed using the Remove Remote Journal (QjoRemoveRemoteJournal) API, or until the journal is deleted. For more information about APIs, see the System API Reference, SC41-5801. .* :PT.:PV.*IGNINQMSG:EPV. :PD.Ignore inquiry message. Inquiry message CPA7025 is not presented to the user, even if this receiver has not been fully saved (for example, a save after the receiver was detached). Also, inquiry message CPA705E is not presented to the user even if the receiver is attached to a remote journal. The delete operation continues. .* :PT.:PV.*IGNEXITPGM:EPV. :PD.Ignore user exit programs. Any user exit programs registered for exit point QIBM_QJO_DLT_JRNRCV are not called and not included in the decision as to whether this journal receiver can be deleted. :EPARML. .* :EHELP. .* .*-------------------------------------------------------------------- .* Hilfetext für Schlüsselwort AGE .*-------------------------------------------------------------------- :HELP name='DLTOLDJRNR/AGE '. Log level - Help :XH3.Log Level (LOGLVL) :P. Specifies the log level of the printed log output. .* :IMHELP name='COM/OPTPARM'. .* :PARML. :PT.:PK.*NONE:EPK. :PD.No log information is printed. :PT.:PV.*BASIC:EPV. :PD.Prints basic information messages. :PT.:PV.*VERBOSE:EPV. :PD.Prints detailed debug information. This log level is recommended in case of problems using DLTOLDJRNR. :EPARML. .* :EHELP. .* .*==================================================================== .* Textbausteine, die an mehreren Stellen im Hilfetext .* verwendet werden. .*====================================================================
